# 上下文设置 / Context settings

> 设置 / Setting

管理长对话的自动压缩行为，包括后台预取压缩与摘要请求的溢出保护。

Manage automatic compression for long conversations, including background compression prefetch and summary-request overflow protection.

## 完整功能清单 / Everything included

- **智能体可定位入口，需交互完成 / Agent opens; interaction required** · 控制是否在接近上下文上限前于后台提前准备压缩
  - Choose whether compression is prepared in the background before the context limit is reached
- **智能体可定位入口，需交互完成 / Agent opens; interaction required** · 控制摘要请求无法再缩小时是否折叠超大围栏或 XML 块
  - Choose whether oversized fenced or XML blocks fold when the summary request cannot shrink further

## 怎么用 / How to use it

1. 打开设置
   Open Settings
2. 进入“AI > 上下文”
   Go to AI > Context
3. 调整自动压缩选项,更改立即保存
   Adjust the automatic compression options; changes save immediately

入口 / Entry: OpenBitFun 设置
